db_table_master.title: DB Full Table/Column Master
db_table_master.description: A comprehensive inventory combining the current platform's normalized DB definitions and the complete table/column set from the HJ-POS legacy. This is the maximum-scope version before filtering; normalization/removal/compatibility layer separation will follow.

purpose.title: Purpose
purpose.content:
This file is a comprehensive inventory that combines the **current platform's normalized DB definitions** and the **complete HJ-POS legacy table/column set** in one place.

The baseline is the maximum-scope version before filtering; normalization/removal/compatibility layer separation will be conducted in separate documents.

current_platform_count.title: Current Platform DB Definitions
current_platform_count.content:
Table groups actually defined in the current platform:

- **Shared/ReferenceData**: Language, Region, Currency, etc. — reference data commonly used by both Central and Edge
- **SuperAdmin/Governance**: SuperAdminUser, PlatformLicense, PlatformPolicy, AuditLog, etc.
- **RegionalDistributor/Channel**: DistributorProfile, Territory, DistributorContract, BrandAssignment, etc.
- **BrandHQ/MasterData**: BrandProfile, Branch, BrandMenuCategory, BrandMenuItem, etc.
- **EdgePOS/OperationalCore**: EdgePosTerminal, Device, DeviceBinding, LocalSetting, etc.

Storage location: Central PostgreSQL (Prisma + raw SQL) + Edge SQLite (C++ native wrapper)

legacy_count.title: Legacy DB Scale
legacy_count.content:
HJ-POS-TEST Legacy DB:

- MSSQL-based
- Covers all domains including orders, payments, tables, customers, inventory, employees, devices, and settings
- Currently migrating to SQLite in the new platform
- Legacy schema is used only as a reverse-engineering reference source

structure.title: Structure
structure.content:
The entire DB is classified into 5 areas:

| Area | Storage Location | Source of Truth |
|---|---|---|
| **Shared Reference Data** | Central PostgreSQL + Edge SQLite cache | Central |
| **SuperAdmin Governance** | Central PostgreSQL | Central |
| **RegionalDistributor Channel** | Central PostgreSQL | Central |
| **BrandHQ MasterData** | Central PostgreSQL | Central |
| **EdgePOS OperationalCore** | Edge SQLite | Edge (local) |

Sync direction: Shared/SuperAdmin/RegionalDistributor/BrandHQ → Downstream (pushed to Edge), EdgePOS → Upstream (pushed to Central)

db_shared_reference.title: Shared Reference Data
db_shared_reference.description: Actual definitions for reference data commonly used by both Central and Edge. Shared assets (SharedAssets) are static assets only; this document covers DB reference data only.

purpose.title: Purpose
purpose.content:
This is the primary actual definition document for reference data commonly used by both Central and Edge.

- Owner: `SuperAdmin/CentralApi`
- Storage location: Central PostgreSQL + Edge SQLite cache
- Source of truth: Central
- Sync direction: Downstream
- Retention policy: Permanent retention
- Deletion policy: Soft delete

language_table.title: Language Table
language_table.content:
| Column Name | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `Id` | uuid / TEXT | Internal identifier |
| `LanguageCode` | varchar(10) | `ko-KR`, `vi-VN`, `en-US` |
| `NativeName` | varchar(100) | Name in native language |
| `DisplayName` | varchar(100) | UI display name |
| `Direction` | varchar(5) | Text direction (LTR/RTL) |
| `IsDefault` | boolean | Whether it is the default language |
| `IsActive` | boolean | Whether it is available |

Unique: `LanguageCode`, Check: `Direction in ('LTR', 'RTL')`

Usage scenarios: Portal/Edge initial language selection, platform initial seed, language name/activation status changes, Edge downloads and uses values from Central

region_table.title: Region Table
region_table.content:
| Column Name | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `Id` | uuid / TEXT | Internal identifier |
| `RegionCode` | varchar(20) | Region code |
| `CountryCode` | varchar(10) | Country code |
| `RegionName` | varchar(120) | Region name |
| `CurrencyCode` | char(3) | Default currency code |
| `TimeZoneCode` | varchar(50) | Default timezone |
| `IsActive` | boolean | Whether it is available |

Unique: `RegionCode`

Usage scenarios: Distributor jurisdiction mapping, automatic application of region-based defaults during Edge initial setup, default values for tax/currency/timezone

currency_table.title: Currency Table
currency_table.content:
| Column Name | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `Id` | uuid / TEXT | Internal identifier |
| `CurrencyCode` | char(3) | ISO 4217 code (KRW, VND, USD) |
| `CurrencyName` | varchar(100) | Currency name |
| `Symbol` | varchar(10) | Display symbol |
| `DecimalPlaces` | integer | Number of decimal places |
| `IsActive` | boolean | Whether it is available |

Unique: `CurrencyCode`

Usage scenarios: Payment amount display, settlement/report currency units, currency conversion reference for multi-country support

db_superadmin_governance.title: SuperAdmin Governance
db_superadmin_governance.description: SuperAdmin platform governance data — operator accounts, licenses, policies, and audit log table definitions.

purpose.title: Purpose
purpose.content:
Defines the core governance tables for the SuperAdmin platform.

- Owner: `SuperAdmin/CentralApi`
- Storage location: Central PostgreSQL
- Sync direction: Downstream (policies/licenses → Edge)
- Consumers: All Portals, CentralApi, SyncWorkers

superadmin_user.title: SuperAdminUser Table
superadmin_user.content:
Platform operator account table.

Key columns: `Id`, `Email`, `DisplayName`, `Role` (PlatformSuperAdmin / PlatformSupportEngineer), `IsActive`, `LastLoginAt`, `CreatedAt`, `UpdatedAt`

Roles:
- **PlatformSuperAdmin**: Create, suspend, deploy, and support multiple brands
- **PlatformSupportEngineer**: Failure analysis, remote support, log access

platform_license.title: PlatformLicense Table
platform_license.content:
License management per brand/region.

Key columns: `Id`, `RegionalDistributorId`, `BrandHQId`, `LicenseType`, `MaxEdgePos`, `ExpiresAt`, `IsActive`, `CreatedAt`, `UpdatedAt`

Usage scenarios:
- Allocate license pools per distributor
- Control maximum EdgePos count per brand
- Expiration alerts and renewal tracking

platform_policy.title: PlatformPolicy Table
platform_policy.content:
Global/regional/brand policy management.

Key columns: `Id`, `PolicyType`, `Scope` (Global / RegionalDistributor / BrandHQ / Branch), `ScopeId`, `PolicyVersion`, `PolicyData` (JSONB), `IsActive`, `CreatedAt`

Usage scenarios:
- Distribute global RBAC policies
- Reflect regional tax/payment regulations
- Manage feature flags per brand

audit_log.title: AuditLog Table
audit_log.content:
Platform-wide audit log.

Key columns: `Id`, `ActorId`, `ActorRole`, `Action`, `TargetType`, `TargetId`, `Detail` (JSONB), `IpAddress`, `CreatedAt`

Usage scenarios:
- Track sensitive data access
- Preserve policy change history
- Reconstruct action timelines during failure root cause analysis

db_distributor_channel.title: RegionalDistributor Channel
db_distributor_channel.description: Table definitions for regional/country distribution partner profiles, territories, contracts, and brand assignments.

purpose.title: Purpose
purpose.content:
Defines the core data tables for the RegionalDistributor tier.

- Owner: `SuperAdmin/CentralApi`
- Storage location: Central PostgreSQL
- Consumers: RegionalDistributorPortal, SuperAdmin/Portal
- Sync direction: Downstream (only necessary information to Edge)

distributor_profile.title: DistributorProfile Table
distributor_profile.content:
Distributor/distribution partner profile.

Key columns: `Id` (= `RegionalDistributorId`), `CompanyName`, `CountryCode`, `ContactEmail`, `ContactPhone`, `Status` (Active / Suspended / Terminated), `CreatedAt`, `UpdatedAt`

Usage scenarios:
- Create/approve/suspend distributors
- Query distributor list by region

territory.title: Territory Table
territory.content:
Distributor jurisdiction mapping.

Key columns: `Id`, `RegionalDistributorId`, `RegionId`, `TerritoryCode`, `IsExclusive`, `EffectiveFrom`, `EffectiveTo`, `IsActive`

Usage scenarios:
- Manage exclusive distribution right periods
- Prevent duplicate regional assignments
- Calculate deployment targets by region

distributor_contract.title: DistributorContract Table
distributor_contract.content:
Distributor contract management.

Key columns: `Id`, `RegionalDistributorId`, `ContractType`, `StartDate`, `EndDate`, `CommissionRate`, `Status` (Draft / Active / Expired / Terminated), `CreatedAt`

Usage scenarios:
- Track contract status
- Manage commission rates
- Renewal alerts

brand_assignment.title: BrandAssignment Table
brand_assignment.content:
Distributor → Brand assignment.

Key columns: `Id`, `RegionalDistributorId`, `BrandHQId`, `AssignedAt`, `RevokedAt`, `IsActive`

Usage scenarios:
- List of brands managed by a distributor
- Automatic distributor linking during brand onboarding
- Assignment revocation history management

db_brandhq_master.title: BrandHQ MasterData
db_brandhq_master.description: Brand headquarters master data — brand profile, branch, menu category, and menu item table definitions.

purpose.title: Purpose
purpose.content:
Defines the master data tables for the BrandHQ tier.

- Owner: `BrandHQ` (via CentralApi)
- Storage location: Central PostgreSQL
- Sync direction: Downstream (menu/pricing/policies → Edge)
- Consumers: BrandHQPortal, EdgePos (local cache after sync)

brand_profile.title: BrandProfile Table
brand_profile.content:
Brand headquarters profile.

Key columns: `Id` (= `BrandHQId`), `BrandName`, `RegionalDistributorId`, `BusinessCategory`, `DefaultLanguageCode`, `DefaultCurrencyCode`, `LogoUrl`, `Status`, `CreatedAt`, `UpdatedAt`

Usage scenarios:
- Brand onboarding
- Distributor → Brand linking
- Brand-level default settings management

branch.title: Branch Table
branch.content:
Branches/stores under a brand.

Key columns: `Id` (= `BranchId`), `BrandHQId`, `BranchName`, `BranchCode`, `Address`, `RegionId`, `TimeZoneCode`, `Status` (Active / Closed / Suspended), `CreatedAt`, `UpdatedAt`

Usage scenarios:
- Create/edit/suspend branches
- Manage per-branch overrides
- Calculate deployment targets

brand_menu_category.title: BrandMenuCategory Table
brand_menu_category.content:
Brand menu categories.

Key columns: `Id`, `BrandHQId`, `CategoryName`, `ParentCategoryId`, `SortOrder`, `IsActive`, `CatalogVersion`, `CreatedAt`, `UpdatedAt`

Usage scenarios:
- Manage menu category hierarchy
- Distribution by catalog version
- Display category tree on Edge

brand_menu_item.title: BrandMenuItem Table
brand_menu_item.content:
Brand menu items (products).

Key columns: `Id`, `BrandHQId`, `CategoryId`, `ItemName`, `ItemCode`, `BasePrice`, `TaxRate`, `Description`, `ImageUrl`, `IsActive`, `CatalogVersion`, `CreatedAt`, `UpdatedAt`

Usage scenarios:
- Product registration/edit
- Pricing policy application
- Menu data delivery during Edge sync

db_edgepos_core.title: EdgePOS OperationalCore
db_edgepos_core.description: Edge POS terminal operational core tables — terminal information, device management, device binding, and local settings definitions.

purpose.title: Purpose
purpose.content:
Defines the operational core tables for the Edge POS terminal.

- Owner: `EdgePos` (local)
- Storage location: Edge SQLite
- Source of truth: Edge (local DB is the source of truth for operational data)
- Sync direction: Upstream (operational data pushed to Central)
- Operating model: **Offline-First**, local commit is the criterion for business success

edge_pos_terminal.title: EdgePosTerminal Table
edge_pos_terminal.content:
Edge POS terminal information.

Key columns: `Id` (= `EdgePosId`), `BrandHQId`, `BranchId`, `RegionalDistributorId`, `TerminalCode`, `TerminalName`, `InstalledVersion`, `LastSyncAt`, `Status` (Active / Offline / Maintenance), `CreatedAt`, `UpdatedAt`

Usage scenarios:
- Load self-identification information at POS startup
- Monitor terminal status from the central platform
- Calculate version deployment targets

device.title: Device Table
device.content:
Peripheral devices connected to EdgePos.

Key columns: `Id` (= `DeviceId`), `EdgePosId`, `DeviceType` (Printer / CardReader / Scanner / Scale / CashDrawer), `DeviceName`, `ConnectionType` (USB / Network / Serial / Bluetooth), `ConnectionAddress`, `Status`, `LastCheckedAt`

Usage scenarios:
- Device registration/discovery
- Real-time connection status verification
- Device history inquiry during failure diagnosis

device_binding.title: DeviceBinding Table
device_binding.content:
Device binding (which device is bound to which role).

Key columns: `Id`, `EdgePosId`, `DeviceId`, `BindingRole` (KitchenPrinter / CustomerPrinter / LabelPrinter / MainCardReader, etc.), `Priority`, `IsActive`, `CreatedAt`

Usage scenarios:
- Kitchen printer routing
- Card reader priority assignment
- Binding configuration in Setup/Maintenance mode

local_setting.title: LocalSetting Table
local_setting.content:
Edge POS local settings (EdgePos Override).

Key columns: `Id`, `EdgePosId`, `SettingKey`, `SettingValue`, `SourceLayer` (Global / RegionalDistributor / BrandHQ / Branch / EdgePos), `PolicyVersion`, `AppliedAt`, `CreatedAt`

Usage scenarios:
- Store the final applied value from the settings inheritance model
- Track which layer a value originated from
- Distinguish between centrally distributed policies and local overrides
